comment: Allow-list of the image-like files that may be committed (see tests/test_tracked_figures.py and src/museum_guide/figures.py).
WikiArt paintings must not be published (dataset licence 'unknown'): figures that show paintings are written to data/figures_local/ instead.
To add an image, look at it first, then add it to 'charts' (curves, bars, tables, matrices, histograms only) with the reason below.

charts.reason: charts only (curves, bars, scatter plots, confusion matrices, histograms): checked by eye, no painting and no third-party photo

needs_decision.presentation/museum-guide.pptx: the 10-minute deck: 11 full-slide images, slides 1 (5 thumbnails) and 9 (10 thumbnails) show WikiArt paintings; kept until the team decides

notebooks_with_plot_outputs.notebooks/museum_guide_walkthrough.ipynb: charts and tables drawn from reports/*.json only, no painting and no third-party photo (checked cell by cell, see the notebook's tests)
